integrity: The proof is analytic. Finite computations in the verifier are corroborative and are not used to establish the infinite-domain theorem. Literature comparisons are limited to the inspected sources and searches described in the review.
scientific_limitations: The result exactly solves only the positive leading gate-cost objective identified as Eq. (7.51) in arXiv:2610.01125v1. It does not solve the full precision-aware geometric program (7.54), analytic-domain feasibility, address-width feedback, exact floor-valued query counts, or total circuit-cost optimality.
title: Exact threshold allocation for MQSP leading gate cost
